subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should this umbrella remain the canonical Anthropic signed-thinking replay tracker until prevention lands, or should maintainers make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 the canonical remaining issue now that recovery and transcript repair are on main?
rationale: Current main has strong recovery mitigation but not prevention; choosing the canonical tracker and replay-policy tradeoff is a maintainer/product decision because the open fix changes Anthropic provider replay semantics.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Prevention Lands
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until a focused prevention PR such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383 lands or is rejected.

options.title: Make The Narrow Issue Canonical
options.body: Close this issue as superseded only after posting a clear handoff to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 and its candidate PR.

options.title: Accept Recovery-Only Scope
options.body: Declare the recovery and durable repair slices sufficient for this umbrella and track prevention as a separate provider-policy improvement.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Prevention Lands
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until a focused prevention PR such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383 lands or is rejected.

likelyOwner.reason: He is already in the issue discussion around the landed recovery half and has direct history in the merged recovery PR, making him the best available routing owner for the provider replay policy choice.
